entries.german:
Abt Hermann und der Konvent von St. Gallen übertragen dem Kloster Magdenau das Eigentumsrecht an Gütern in Flawil und Umgebung gegen das Eigentumsrecht am Hof Helfenberg.

Hermannus dei et apostolice sedis gratia electus et confirmatus in abbatem monasterii sancti Galli 1 totusque conventus monasterii predicti ordinis sancti Benedicti dyocesis Constanciensis universis presencium inspectoribus salutem cum noticia subscriptorum. Consciencie puritas || et religionis integritas nos informat, ut pia et devota loca respiciamus ex debito et eorum utilitatibus propensius intendamus, in quibus religionis integritas, regularis observancia cultusque divini nominis frequencius exercentur. Hinc est, quod, cum devote in Christo abbatissa totusque conventus || monasterii in Maggenowe 2 ordinis Cysterciensis nobis humiliter supplicarint, ut nos propter deum et propter divini cultus aucmentum eidem cenobio seu conventui in Maggenowe hanc gratiam inpendere dignaremur, quod bona et possessiones, que inferius sub certis nominibus exprimuntur et in quibus discretos ac nobiles || viros Růdolfum dictum Giel de Liebenberg 3 militem, Růdolfum dictum Giel de Glatburg 4 seniorem, Eglolfum de Rosenberg 5 seniorem, V olricum et Hainricum dictos Giel de Glatburg 6 germanos et Hainricum dictum de Hûsen 7 civem Episcopaliscelle 8 hactenus memoratus conventus fideles habuerat portitores seu trager vulgariter nuncupatos, posset inantea tamquam sibi directo et utili dominio pertinentes de voluntate nostra expressa et consensu unanimi adhibito licite possidere, nos iuxta iuris sollempnitatem tractatu prehabito diligenti considerantes eiusdem conventus pia ac religiosa opera, que in eo cum desiderio salubriter perpetrantur, et liberalitatem beneficii nobis nostroque monasterio voluntarie exhibiti et inpensi, videlicet quod omne ius seu dominium, quod eidem conventui in curia dicta Helfenberg 9 et omnibus suis pertinenciis conpetiit seu conpetere poterat quoquo modo, nobis nostroque monasterio de voluntate expressa totaliter cum omnibus suis iuribus libere resignarunt, prenotati conventus iustis ac raciona[bi]libus a) supplicacionibus inclinati in memoratum conventum pure ac simpliciter propter deum quoad verum directum et utile dominium bona et possessiones transferimus infrascriptas, videlicet molendinum in Flâwile 10 cum possessione dicta das múlgůt, curiam dictam der mayierhof ze Flâwile, possession[em dict]am a) das Gupflehen 11 in Flâwile, curiam dictam Edakswîle 12, decimam in Rosrúti 13, possessionem dictam vffen der Egge 14, decimam curie in Sôrendal 15, possessionem dictam Hûsner gu etli sitam in Oberndorf 16 et pratum dictum Watwis 17 ibidem situm, decimam in Gebratswile b)18 in possessione dicta das Bachlê[n 17 et] a) decimam in possessione dicta dú Hasahůb 17 in Gebratswile b). Has quidem possessiones prenotatas, quas prenominati portitores a nostro monasterio tenebant in feodum, ad manus nostras resignatas 19 et ab ipsis omnino liberas resumentes universas et singulas sub prestacione annui census videlicet trium [li]brarum a) cere in festo beati Galli abbati nostri monasterii, qui pro tempore fuerit, annis singulis in suam cameram solvendarum ipsi conventui in Maggenowe, sive feodales fuerint sive proprie, pleno iure concedimus annectimus et donamus libere et quiete sine inpugnacione qualibet in perpetuum [. . .]endas c), ita tamen, quod per concessionem huiusmodi et annexionem monasterium nostrum et ecclesie vel cappelle quecumque serviciis censibus et iuribus eisdem possessionibus inpositis antea nullatenus defraudentur. Et si dictus conventus aliquibus hominibus ad fictum vel ad firmum pro tempore vite eorum, in perpetu[um] a) vel ad tempus usufructum vel pensionem in predictis bonis seu possessionibus constituerit vel vendiderit vel adhuc vendat vel constituat, per hoc in bonis vel possessionibus predictis nobis nostroque monasterio nullum ius aquiritur nec eidem conventui quoad verum vel ad utile dominium eorundem bonorum ali[quod] a) preiudicium generatur, sed expleto usufructu possessiones, in quibus constitutus fuerat, ad ipsum conventum libere revertantur, hoc etiam adiecto, quod predictus conventus, si forte necessitate vel aliquo casu urgente possessiones vel bona predicta vel ex ipsis aliquam alienare contingerit, easdem possessionis a) et bona aliis personis et hominibus quam nostro monasterio pertinentibus et vulgariter dictis in der gnôssami vendere et alienare non debent nec vendendi vel alienandi aliter aliquam habeant potestatem, renunciantes insuper beneficio restitucionis in integrum ac omni iuris auxilio, per quod premissa omnia universaliter possent infringi vel eorum quodlibet particulariter in toto vel in parte aliqualiter infirmari. In cuius rei evidens testimonium sigilla nostra duximus presentibus appendenda. Datum et actum apud sanctum Gallum, anno domini millesimo tricentesimo quadragesimo primo, pridie kalendas novembris, indictione decima.

Siegel: 2 Siegel an farblosen Schnüren, 1. fehlt; 2. besch., Abb. 94.
entries.english:
Abbot Hermann and the convent of St. Gallen transfer ownership of properties in Flawil and its vicinity to the monastery of Magdenau in exchange for ownership of the Helfenberg estate.

Hermann, by the grace of God and the Apostolic See elected and confirmed abbot of the monastery of St. Gallen, and the whole convent of that monastery, of the Order of St. Benedict in the diocese of Constance, send greetings to all who see this document and knowledge of what follows. The purity of conscience and integrity of religious life instruct us that we ought to care for pious and devout houses and attend especially to their welfare, where religious integrity, regular observance, and worship of the divine name are frequently practiced. Therefore, when the devout abbess in Christ and the whole convent of the monastery of Magdenau, of the Cistercian Order, humbly petitioned us, asking that for God's sake and the increase of divine worship we grant this favor to that convent: that it might henceforth lawfully possess, as belonging to it in direct and beneficial ownership, the properties and possessions specified below, in which the prudent and noble men Rudolf called Giel von Liebenberg, knight; Rudolf called Giel von Glatburg the Elder; Egilolf von Rosenberg the Elder; Ulrich and Heinrich called Giel von Glatburg, brothers; and Heinrich called von Hüsen, citizen of Wil, had until now served the aforesaid convent as faithful holders, commonly called carriers.

After careful deliberation in accordance with legal procedure, considering the convent's pious and religious works and the generous benefit freely bestowed upon us and our monastery—namely, that the convent freely surrendered to us and our monastery, with all its rights, every right or ownership it had or could have had in any way in the estate called Helfenberg and all its appurtenances—we granted the convent's just and reasonable petition. Purely and simply, for God's sake, we transfer to the aforesaid convent, as true direct and beneficial ownership, the following properties and possessions: the mill at Flawil with the property called das Mülgut; the estate called der Maierhof zu Flawil; the property called das Gupflehen at Flawil; the estate called Edakschwil; the tithe at Rosrüti; the property called uff der Egge; the tithe of the estate at Sörendal; the property called Hüsner Güetli at Oberndorf and the meadow called Watwis there; the tithe at Gebratswil in the property called das Bachlehen; and the tithe in the property called die Hasahub at Gebratswil.

Taking back these properties, which the aforesaid holders held in fief from our monastery, after they had surrendered them into our hands and freed them completely, we grant, attach, and give all of them, whether feudal or allodial, to the convent of Magdenau in full right, freely and peacefully and forever, subject to an annual payment of three pounds of wax to the abbot of our monastery, whoever he may be at the time, on the feast of Saint Gall, to be paid each year into his chamber. This grant and annexation shall not deprive our monastery, or any church or chapel, of the services, dues, and rights previously imposed on these properties. If the convent grants or sells to anyone, for life, in perpetuity, or for a term, a usufruct or rent in these goods or properties, whether it has already done so or does so in the future, this shall confer no right in them upon us or our monastery and shall cause the convent no prejudice in its direct or beneficial ownership. Once the usufruct ends, the properties concerned shall freely revert to the convent. We further stipulate that if the convent should need to alienate any of these properties or goods, it may sell or alienate them only to persons other than our monastery who belong to the group commonly called the Gnossami; it shall have no power to sell or alienate them otherwise. We also renounce the benefit of restitution in integrum and every legal remedy by which all or any part of the foregoing could be wholly or partly invalidated. As clear proof of this matter, we have caused our seals to be attached to this document. Given and enacted at St. Gallen in the year of the Lord 1341, on the day before the Kalends of November, in the tenth indiction.

Two seals on colorless cords; the first is missing, the second damaged; illustration 94.
